title: irlpls Order request (DRAFT)
description: Body of POST {endpoint}/orders, sent with an Idempotency-Key header. Either an accepted offer (quote_id + offer_id) or a direct order (request + constraints.max_total, the provider never charging more). Draft: docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md.

oneOf.description: An accepted offer: quote_id is a quote this server issued (at a provider, the provider's own quote).

nonce.description: Required. At least 128 random bits, base64url. Echoed in every receipt; shown in the scene when scene_nonce is set (the provider gives it to the capturer once the order exists).

approval.description: Informative: how the buyer side authorised this spend. A provider cannot verify it.

client_reference.description: The client's own reference; GET {endpoint}/orders?client_reference= finds the order again. MUST NOT carry personal data.
